assertions.claim: Sudden whole-body rash plus breathlessness or dizziness is treated as anaphylactic shock: immediate 120, say 'suspected anaphylactic shock' so the crew brings adrenaline.
assertions.cn_span: 突然全身起疹，再加上喘不上气或者发晕，就按过敏性休克办

assertions.claim: Adrenaline is first-line; antihistamines and steroids act slowly and cannot take its place.
assertions.cn_span: 肾上腺素是一线药，抗过敏药和激素起效慢，顶不了这个位置

assertions.claim: Those who had one episode should get an auto-injector prescribed; injected into the mid-outer thigh, through clothing too.
assertions.cn_span: 有过一次的人找医生开自动注射笔，打大腿中外侧，隔着裤子也能打

assertions.claim: EAACI itself states evidence mostly remains very low-grade; the strong recommendation comes from benefit far outweighing risk, not large trials.
assertions.cn_span: EAACI 自己写明这个领域「证据大多停留在很低的等级」

assertions.claim: Adrenaline in China is prescription-only, ordinary people usually don't have it; known severe allergy → paying for one's own auto-injector.
assertions.cn_span: 肾上腺素在国内是处方药，普通人手上通常没有
